guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, complete_o is asynchronously reset to 0. When rst_ni is high, on each rising edge of clk_i, complete_o is updated to the value of complete_d.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni low (reset) or rising clk_i with rst_ni high

assumptions.claim: complete_d is a valid and stable logic value before the positive clock edge, representing the intended completion status for the next cycle.
assumptions.cond: when not in reset and on every rising clk_i
assumptions.risk: If complete_d is unstable or contains glitches, complete_o may latch an incorrect value, causing the Keccak round to report a wrong completion state, potentially leading to premature or stuck completion.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni de-assertion must meet asynchronous reset recovery and removal timing relative to clk_i to avoid metastability on complete_o.
assumptions.risk: Metastability on complete_o could propagate an undefined completion signal, causing the Keccak engine to misinterpret completion status and leading to functional failure.
